# Offline H.264 client profile-selection prototype

**AI disclosure:** This file, including its title and all prose, was generated by AI.

Bounded deliverable for [omarchy-m1-video#41](https://github.com/iconidentify/omarchy-m1-video/issues/41).
It reproduces FFmpeg n9.0.1's VA-API profile refusal for Baseline/Extended
streams, then proposes a feature-aware remap onto already-advertised
Constrained Baseline / Main profiles.

This is **not** hardware decode, not a 73-to-78 Fluster increase, and not
whole-profile Baseline or Extended support. Parent
[libva-v4l2_request#37](https://github.com/iconidentify/libva-v4l2_request/issues/37)
stays open for the five exact checksums, safe negotiation on a real client,
and the complete 135-vector comparison.

## Run

From the repository root, no extra Python packages, no `/dev/video*`, no sudo:

```
python3 experiments/h264-profile-selection/validate.py
python3 experiments/h264-profile-selection/validate.py --self-test
python3 experiments/h264-profile-selection/validate.py --source-map
python3 experiments/h264-profile-selection/validate.py --decision
```

`--self-test` runs the fixtures and `tests.py`. Every result prints
`decoded_frame_evidence=false`. Fixtures are synthetic JSON inventories
derived from published research; they do not embed, download or require
the ITU/Fluster AVC corpus.

## What is modelled

Two paths against a stub of the profiles this driver advertises
(`VAProfileH264ConstrainedBaseline`, `Main`, `High`, `High10`):

* `current` — FFmpeg n9.0.1 `vaapi_decode_make_config`
  (`bf1b838f2ab88b4f8fd83443325c782ea0e0f7fa`). The H.264 rows of
  `vaapi_profile_map` exact-match Constrained Baseline / Main / High / High10
  only. Baseline (`profile_idc=66` without `constraint_set1_flag`) and
  Extended (`88`) fail unless `AV_HWACCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_PROFILE_MISMATCH` is
  set. That flag keeps the last advertised mapped profile, which is High
  when this driver is used — not a feature-safe subset.
* `proposed` — scan every picture's SPS/PPS/slice inventory. FMO
  (`num_slice_groups_minus1 > 0`), fields (`frame_mbs_only_flag=0`, MBAFF
  or `field_pic_flag`), data-partition NALs 2/3/4 and malformed headers
  reject. Otherwise map CB-safe Baseline (I/P, progressive, no FMO) to
  Constrained Baseline, and Main-safe Extended (I/P/B, progressive, no FMO)
  to Main. Ordinary Main/High/Constrained Baseline exact matches are
  unchanged. No default `allow_profile_mismatch`. No Baseline/Extended VA
  profile is advertised.

The five candidate inventories (BA3_SVA_C, MR2–MR5_TANDBERG) come from
`docs/plans/issue-10-h264-field-mbaff.md` section 3.2 and
`docs/H264_ADVANCED_SYNTAX.md`. They are not re-scanned here and their
hardware MD5s are not claimed.

## Decision

The installed client API **cannot express this safely**.

VA `CreateConfig` takes a `VAProfile`, not a feature inventory. FFmpeg
chooses that profile in `vaapi_decode_make_config` from `avctx->profile`
before later PPS/NAL changes. There is no VA query for "this Baseline
stream is Constrained-Baseline-compatible". Advertising whole Baseline or
Extended profiles would send FMO/field/partition syntax at the hardware.
`allow_profile_mismatch` is a blanket High fallback on this stack, not a
subset remap.

A safe implementation belongs in a **local FFmpeg change** that:

1. Inspects SPS *and* PPS (FMO is a PPS field; SPS-only detectors miss it).
2. Remaps Baseline→Constrained Baseline or Extended→Main only when the
   scanned features fit those subsets.
3. Re-checks on a parameter-set change (FM1_FT_E grows slice groups later).
4. Leaves installer/package FFmpeg and driver advertised profiles alone.

Until that client contract exists, keep the explicit per-file
`-hwaccel_flags allow_profile_mismatch` workaround for lab overrides and
do not put it in user defaults. The local patch
`ffmpeg-n9.0.1-h264-vaapi-feature-select.patch` is a sketch against
n9.0.1; it is not applied, not installed, and not sent upstream.

## What this does not do

* No installer, package pin, kernel `patches/`, or driver `src/` edits.
* No `/dev/video*`, sudo, module operations or corpus download.
* No claim that `status=select` means a frame compared equal to a reference.
* Main-profile interlaced streams still exact-match Main in both paths;
  kernel SPS rejection of `!FRAME_MBS_ONLY` stays with the field tickets.

## Review regressions

Negative tests in `tests.py` turn off FMO, field, partition and whole-stream
scans one at a time. The matching reject fixtures then select Constrained
Baseline and the fixture `ok` bit fails. Midstream FMO is picture index 2.

Run `--self-test` for the shipped fixtures and unittests. The validator is
registered in offline CI.
